name: Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates and admission model are not confirmed.

english.toefl: 80 overall / 15 each section before January 21, 2026; 4.5 overall and each section thereafter
english.note: duolingo: 115 overall; 110 each subsection. ielts: 6.5 overall; 6.0 each subsection. Scores valid two years. Alternatives include approved intensive English programs, 60 US semester hours within 36 months, or a listed-country degree with two years attendance. Special Indian NAAC-A institution routes also apply; conditional admission may be possible.

requirements.note: Biology PhD GRE minimum 310 quantitative + verbal and 3.0 writing; catalog allows case-by-case waiver for qualified applicants. Minimum GPA 3.0/4.0; bachelor's in the discipline or closely allied preparation. Master's not normally required for full-time PhD, but may be for part-time. Central application instructions normally request two PhD recommendations; confirm program-specific requirements.
